row: The Eisenhower Health channel brings you helpful healthcare information and insights. Videos in this channel include topics such as: updated information about the advanced technology Eisenhower employs, topical healthcare issues such as tips on managing summer heat, flu and dealing with the allergy season.  Other important topics covered include: cancer treatment, ER vs. urgent care, cardiovascular and chest pain, inpatient rehabilitation, women's health, diabetes, wound care, stroke and orthopedic topics. Of course, we are also proud of our teaching hospital and offer videos to bring you up to speed on how that's improving healthcare in the Coachella Valley area and around the world. We also have videos covering information about our numerous satellite facilities throughout Palm Springs, La Quinta, Palm Desert, Rancho Mirage and Cathedral City.
